name: magnific-mcp
description: Generate images from text or an attached reference artifact and upscale images through Magnific MCP with interruption-safe reactive monitoring, duplicate-safe delivery attempts, and artifact output.

MCP_PROFILE.prompt: Chat-scoped mcp-client profile used for Magnific.

PREPARATION_TTL_MS.prompt: How long prepared upscale parameters remain usable.

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.prompt: Maximum source image size in bytes.

RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: Maximum time to wait for a completed upscale.
